aboutPage.title: About - {{name}}
aboutPage.jobSubtitle: I build accessible, performant, and delightful web experiences.

philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.content: The best interfaces are born where technology meets people. After {{experienceYears}} years in UI, I've learned that understanding users and perfecting every detail is key. I create applications that are smooth, visually striking, and accessible to everyone—without compromise.

experience.title: What I Do
experience.content: I design complex, interactive, and high-performance user interfaces. From responsive layouts to performance optimization, every project is a blend of design and technical excellence. My apps are intuitive, user-friendly, and rock-solid under the hood.

process.title: My Process
process.description: I start by deeply understanding the user's needs and the project's goals. Then, I translate these insights into efficient, polished code. I believe in collaboration and iteration—the best products are built in teams and refined continuously.

afterHours.title: After Hours
afterHours.content: When I’m not coding, I’m exploring—new technologies, travel destinations, and world cuisines. I’m passionate about games, movies, and series, and fascinated by dreams and artificial intelligence. Oh, and I have a little secret… see for yourself.

meta.title: Experience of Kamil Pinas - Frontend Development Journey
meta.description: Explore the professional journey of Kamil Pinas, a Frontend Developer and UI Engineer, with a detailed timeline of his projects and experiences.

zebra.title: Zebra (Aurora Focus) - Industrial Vision & AI Platform
zebra.subtitle: Frontend Developer / UI Engineer

details.0: I designed and developed a desktop application (Electron) for industrial operations, integrating the UI with Node.js backends and C++ components responsible for hardware communication.
details.1: I built the application communication layer: handling device events, ensuring stable data channels, and keeping the UI resilient to temporary outages or incomplete data.
details.2: I used PixiJS (WebGL) to render high-frequency dynamic visualizations (overlays, markers, previews), avoiding the performance limits of the traditional DOM.
details.3: I optimized rendering performance by controlling the render loop, reducing allocations, reusing graphical resources, and limiting repaint/reflow costs.
details.4: I designed application state in React using Context API and custom hooks, keeping state predictable, debuggable, and scalable as features grew.
details.5: I integrated real-time AI/OCR streams into the UI: presenting results, live updates, and a smooth operator feedback loop (mark/accept/reject).
details.6: I built operator tooling within the UI: configurations, profiles, process parameters, validations, and safeguards to prevent incorrect setup.
details.7: I improved desktop app stability: exception handling, logging, failure scenarios, and regression reduction while expanding modules.
details.8: I collaborated with deployment/production teams, translating real workstation and production-line workflows into UI requirements (ergonomics, readability, minimizing clicks).

details.0: I developed a high-performance, conversion-focused landing page for a boutique event rental business using React 18 and Vite.
details.1: I designed and implemented a dynamic product catalog with categorized displays for modern bounce houses and soft play equipment.
details.2: I crafted a fluid UI/UX with Framer Motion, implementing scroll-linked animations and staggered entrance effects to create an engaging 'alive' feel.
details.3: I integrated direct lead generation via EmailJS for seamless client-side booking inquiries without a dedicated backend.
details.4: I implemented a comprehensive SEO strategy using React Helmet Async and JSON-LD structured data to enhance local search visibility.
details.5: I built a type-safe, reusable UI component library using Tailwind CSS and Class Variance Authority (CVA).
details.6: I established an automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for deployment to Cloudflare Pages' global edge network.
details.7: I optimized the application for maximum performance, achieving rapid load times and smooth interactions across all mobile and desktop devices.

details.0: I built a modern SPA website using React (Vite + Tailwind CSS), focusing on fast load times, responsiveness, and a structure that supports easy future content updates.
details.1: I designed the component and page structure to scale cleanly (e.g., portfolio, services, FAQ, contact) without rewriting UI foundations.
details.2: I delivered a mobile-first experience: layout, grid, typography, and UI components (headings, cards, CTAs) aligned with real mobile user behavior.
details.3: I improved SEO within the typical SPA constraints: semantic HTML, correct heading hierarchy, meta tags, descriptions, OpenGraph data, and controlled page/section titles and descriptions.
details.4: I ensured practical accessibility best practices: clear keyboard focus states, correct labels, sufficient color contrast, and predictable navigation (aligned with common WCAG expectations for standard UI elements).
details.5: I optimized frontend assets: image compression and format selection, lazy-loading, trimming heavy dependencies, and monitoring bundle size.
details.6: I implemented lead capture/contact forms with client-side validation, clear error states, basic anti-spam protections, and consistent success feedback.
details.7: I set up analytics and basic event tracking (e.g., CTA clicks, form submissions) so the business owner could measure website and campaign effectiveness.
details.8: I prepared a reliable publishing flow: environment setup, automated builds, and deployments (CI/CD) to keep updates fast and safe.
details.9: I delivered structured handover documentation: how to update content, project structure overview, and key technical decisions.

details.0: I contributed to the UI for SCADVANCE XP—an IDS platform focused on OT/SCADA network monitoring—designed around events, alerts, and telemetry data.
details.1: I implemented operational screens: alert lists, incident details, event history, and analyst-friendly views that help move quickly from signal to context.
details.2: I built components for high-density data presentation: advanced tables, multi-criteria filtering, sorting, pagination, and comparison views.
details.3: I delivered visual elements that support analysis: trends/charts and lightweight correlation-style views to reduce “time to diagnosis” for end users.
details.4: I ensured consistent UX in a security-oriented application: clear severity levels, empty states, error messaging, and predictable actions across the interface.
details.5: I worked within constraints typical for higher-assurance environments: careful library choices, UI risk control, and strong emphasis on stability and predictable behavior.
details.6: I collaborated on iterative requirement refinement: reviewing mockups, finalizing component behaviors, and aligning UX with real incident-handling procedures.
details.7: I improved code quality through UI refactors, bug fixes, and addressing edge cases triggered by irregular or unexpected input data.

details.0: Established a self-owned B2B company to provide specialized software development and consulting services.
I developed and maintained a B2B enterprise application (React + TypeScript) for managing users, organizational structure, permissions, and a device fleet.
details.1: I designed and delivered domain-oriented UI modules (split into functional areas), focusing on clear separation of responsibilities and long-term maintainability.
details.2: I implemented advanced list and detail views (CRUD) with validation, transitional/loading states, error handling, and consistent user-facing feedback (UX optimized for data-heavy workflows).
details.3: I built complex AG Grid tables for large datasets: column configuration, custom cell renderers, multi-field filtering, sorting, pinning, grouping, and persisted grid state.
details.4: I improved performance for data-heavy screens by reducing unnecessary re-renders, applying memoization, introducing code-splitting (lazy loading), and profiling bottlenecks in the browser.
details.5: I created interactive D3.js visualizations for computer-vision-related metrics (e.g., time trends, distributions, multi-series comparisons), focusing on clarity and analytical usability.
details.6: I added rich chart interactions (tooltips, range selection, zoom/scale, series highlighting) so users could quickly identify anomalies and correlations.
details.7: I delivered client-side report export: generating PDFs directly from application views, with attention to layout, pagination, consistent styling, and cross-browser reliability.
details.8: I standardized implementation patterns (shared components, strict typing, conventions), reducing technical debt and improving onboarding and code review efficiency.
details.9: I worked closely with product and backend teams: refining requirements, breaking features into tasks, aligning API contracts, and iterating on UX based on real user scenarios.
details.10: I helped keep releases stable through systematic code reviews, regression fixes, and ongoing maintenance of critical modules across multiple iterations.

bachelor.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
bachelor.subtitle: Katedra Informatyki Akademii Tarnowskiej

details.0: I completed a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science, building strong fundamentals in programming, algorithms and data structures, databases, and software architecture.
details.1: I delivered both individual and team projects covering requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and technical documentation.
details.2: I developed practical engineering habits: using version control, organizing codebases, debugging, breaking down problems, and consistently delivering completed features.
details.3: I gained hands-on experience with relational databases: data modeling, normalization, writing queries, and designing simple data access layers.
details.4: I built a maintainability-first mindset: clear module boundaries, consistent naming, purposeful comments, and clean project structure.
